Secondly, tragedy has all the elements of the epic —it◀ can even use the hexameter—and in addition a considerable element of its own in the spectacle and the music, which make the pleasure all the more vivid; and this vividness can be felt whether it is read or acted. Another point is that it attains its end with greater economy of length.
